resources.name: Periodic DFT code with hybrid functional support (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, ABINIT)

access.notes: Academic/open-source codes. Support for B3PW or equivalent hybrid functionals and norm-conserving/PAW pseudopotentials is needed.

resources.name: Pseudopotentials and basis sets for Ti, Sr, Ba, O

access.notes: For LCAO-based codes: Hay-Wadt ECPs and Gaussian basis sets (O 8-411(1d)G, Ti 411(311d)G, Sr/Ba 311(1d)G) from Ref. [22]. For plane-wave codes: equivalent norm-conserving or PAW pseudopotentials.
